name: Seeming

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: any number of creatures you can see

summary: Give any number of creatures you can see new illusory appearances.
text: An unwilling target can make a Cha save to avoid it. A creature can see through a disguise with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
